# your.name

> Personal site template. Live Discord presence card, a music page and a small translation setup.
> Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No framework, no bundler, no tracking.
> Live Discord presence card, a track list, and translations in English and Spanish.

## Pages

- [Home]({{SITE_URL}}/): Introduction plus a live presence card with Discord
  status, current activity and the song playing right now.
- [Bio]({{SITE_URL}}/bio): Who I am, what I work on and the tools I use.
- [Music]({{SITE_URL}}/music): The songs I keep on repeat, with album artwork.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/your-username

## Technical notes

- Every page is server-rendered plain HTML. The view source contains the
  full text of the site.
- Presence data comes from the public, read-only Lanyard API.
- The track list is plain HTML with progressive enhancement.
- Structured data (JSON-LD) describes the person, the site and the list.
- Navigation between pages happens without reloading, so nothing flickers.
